arStrings.szText: {c_important}Zeal{/c} extends its assault, randomly seeking surrounding enemies and striking {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} additional times.

{c_important}Zeal{/c} costs {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|%x|]{/c} Maximum Life instead of Faith and strikes around you in a circle. 

Whenever you lose Life, {c_important}Zeal's{/c} damage increases by  {c_number}[{SF_30} * 100|%|]{/c} and Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}[{SF_32} * 100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Zeal's{/c} cleave is larger, gains {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} additional strikes, and deals {c_number}[{SF_23} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies.

{c_important}Zeal{/c} has an additional {c_number}[{SF_42} * 100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance.

Double this bonus against {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies.

Critically Striking enemies with {c_important}Zeal{/c} has a {c_number}[SF_44*100|%|]{/c} chance to grant {c_number}[SF_40*100|%|]{/c} of Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:FORTIFY})|0|]){/c} as {u}{c_important}Fortify{/c}{/u}.
